verdict.rationale: Sprint planning is a fair axis for a work-tracking tool like Trello, but the evidence never documents sprint features such as iterations, sprint backlogs, velocity, or burndown. It shows only general visual boards and templates, a Power-Up for viewing Jira work, and community users arranging Idea→Doing→Done boards. These are adjacent features and user-side workarounds, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can plan and manage sprints for agile software development
